title: Statistical Audit, Bayesian Diagnostics, and Reproducibility
paragraphs: Appendix O Statistical Audit, Bayesian Diagnostics, and Reproducibility This appendix holds the statistical audit conducted in the review workspace alongside the thesis. Every block is marked FRESH (recomputed in this package from versioned artifacts by a tracked Python script) or INHERITED (transcribed verbatim from thesis exports and not re-run). The generator scripts, inputs, and machine-readable outputs live under 04_statistical_audit of the review package; their hashes are registered in the reproducibility manifest in Section O.4. No number in this appendix was invented; each row names its source artifact or script. O.1 Provenance Split of the Audit Blocks O.2 Bayesian Diagnostics Certicate The certicate transcribes the three blocks reproduced in Section 6.10: a fresh SMC-ABC calibration, the parsed beta-binomial consensus model for SR', and the inherited PyMC hierarchical model. Within each block the distinction between re-estimated and inherited is explicit, so the certicate cannot be mistaken for a complete re-estimation. 322

APPENDIX O. STATISTICAL AUDIT, BAYESIAN DIAGNOSTICS, AND REPRODUCIBILITY 325 O.3 Joint Display: Synthetic Agents Against Real Qualitative Records The GMM cluster-to-ground-truth joint display links each synthetic-agent cluster in the frozen persona-s42 latent space to its nearest real qualitative records. It is an audit artifact for future anchor selection, not a claim that the synthetic agents are the real cases. Demo FGD/self-report records are never quoted; only non-demo records carrying verbatim text are eligible as anchors, and quotes are excerpts rather than consent-cleared full statements. APPENDIX O. STATISTICAL AUDIT, BAYESIAN DIAGNOSTICS, AND REPRODUCIBILITY 326 O.4 Reproducibility Manifest The manifest follows reproducibility-manifest/1.0, records the seeds used across the workow, and registers a SHA-256 hash for every input and output artifact. The complete machine-readable manifest and its verifying generator are in the review package under 04_statistical_audit/reproducibility_manifest.json and 04_statistical_audit/reproducibility_manifest.py. APPENDIX O. STATISTICAL AUDIT, BAYESIAN DIAGNOSTICS, AND REPRODUCIBILITY 327 (they live on the gated Colab/Kaggle runners), and that no self-report ground-truth export or Kaggle social-media wave is present as an artifact. Recording absence is honest provenance; it prevents the manifest from being mistaken for a complete run record. Reproducibility therefore means: running the frozen artifact hashes and tracked generator scripts, not re-executing the external runners from this workspace.
